name: Apex 版本反馈演示项目
demo_disclaimer: 演示数据为虚构内容，不代表真实 Apex 玩家反馈。

article.title: 虚构 Designer’s Notes：内部演示版本

sections.heading: STARANCHOR
paragraphs: Fictional demo: Tactical cooldown increased from 20s to 25s.

sections.heading: MOLTENWING
paragraphs: Fictional demo: Passive reliability improved after taking damage.

sections.heading: MISTWALKER
paragraphs: Fictional demo: Ultimate visibility behavior adjusted for both teams.

article.text: 这是完全虚构的演示文章，不代表 EA 官方改动。

changes.change_summary: 虚构：延长星锚战术技能的冷却窗口。
changes.original_problem: 高频位移压缩对手反应时间。
changes.source_excerpt: Fictional demo: Tactical cooldown increased from 20s to 25s.

changes.change_summary: 虚构：提高熔羽被动技能在受击后的可靠性。
changes.design_goal: 减少被动被轻易打断的情况。
changes.original_problem: 被动在实战中过于不稳定。
changes.source_excerpt: Fictional demo: Passive reliability improved after taking damage.

changes.change_summary: 虚构：调整雾巡终极技能的视野遮挡机制。
changes.design_goal: 让交战双方获得更清晰的反馈。
changes.original_problem: 遮挡信息过强且反馈不一致。
changes.source_excerpt: Fictional demo: Ultimate visibility behavior adjusted for both teams.
